Name: MH Smart Crop Bubbles
Author: mahsouto
Description:
[center][size=6][b]MH Smart Crop Bubbles[/b][/size][/center]

[size=5][b]What is MH Smart Crop Bubbles?[/b][/size]

MH Smart Crop Bubbles is a visual helper mod that displays informative bubbles above your planted crops, making it easy to identify what's growing in your fields at a glance. With smart color-coded status indicators and advanced filtering options, you'll never lose track of what you planted or which crops need attention!

[size=5][b]Features[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Visual Crop Display[/b] - Shows the actual crop icon above each planted crop (harvest or seed icon)
[*][b]Smart Status Indicators[/b] - Color-coded bubbles show crop status: green when ready to harvest, blue when needs water, red when needs fertilizer
[*][b]Unplanted Soil Detection[/b] - Shows bubbles on tilled soil with no crops, with optional sprinkler range filtering (compatible with Line Sprinklers Redux)
[*][b]Fruit Trees & Bushes Support[/b] - Display indicators on fruit trees and berry bushes (tea bushes, blackberries, salmonberries)
[*][b]Advanced Filter System[/b] - Cycle through display modes: All Crops, Ready to Harvest, Needs Water, Needs Fertilizer, and more combinations
[*][b]Quick Toggle Hotkeys[/b] - Instant on/off toggles for unplanted soil, fruit trees, and bushes with on-screen notifications
[*][b]Days Remaining Counter[/b] - Optional display showing days until harvest with customizable size, position, fonts, and background
[*][b]Custom Colors[/b] - Full RGB color customization for each status and element (requires GMCMOptions mod)
[*][b]Flexible Display Options[/b] - Toggle or hold key to show/hide bubbles
[*][b]Scarecrow Range Detection[/b] - Identify crops without scarecrow coverage with color indicators
[*][b]Customizable Appearance[/b] - Adjust bubble size, opacity, colors, and icon types to your preference
[*][b]Location Filtering[/b] - Option to show only on farm locations
[/list]
[size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]

[b]Fully Compatible:[/b]
[list]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu (recommended)
[*]GMCMOptions (optional - for RGB color customization)
[*]All major farming mods
[*]Greenhouse and indoor farming
[*]Modded crops and locations
[*]Tractor Mod, Automate, and automation mods
[/list]

[b]Notes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Works with vanilla and modded crops
[*]Compatible with all farm layouts
[*]No conflicts with visual enhancement mods
[*]GMCMOptions mod required only for advanced color picker functionality
[*]The description has been translated from Spanish.
[/list]
